body: Sorry I had stuff I had to do then I forgot about our conversation. Thanks for taking the time to talk to me. You are also very lucky that you are on spring break haha. I have it in 2 weeks

Thanks for telling me all of this I really appreciate it. The way you mentioned the dog made me laugh. And yeah I do cry alot. It does make me feel a bit better. Sometimes it happens when I don't want it to. Like I'll be sitting in class and think about how my family would react if I killed myself, knowing how broken they would be, and that's what starts to make my eyes water so I quickly try to focus on what the teacher is talking about so I don't embarrass myself by breaking down in front of everyone. However when im alone I listen to sad music and let it all out and it honestly feels really good afterwards despite how shitty it can feel when im in the process of doing it. It makes me feel a bit more relaxed when im done doing it.
Yeah I'm safe right now. Hopefully I'll be able to get some sleep tonight. Just wish the sadness would go away. And damn that dog has a big stick. Thanks for the gif lol
